terms.definitionEn: An arithmetic operation that combines numeric values.
terms.definitionAr: عملية حسابية بتجمع قيم رقمية مع بعض.

terms.definitionEn: An arithmetic operation that finds the difference between values.
terms.definitionAr: عملية حسابية بتطرح قيمة من التانية عشان نعرف الفرق بينهم.

terms.definitionEn: An arithmetic operation that scales a value by another value.
terms.definitionAr: عملية حسابية بتضرب قيمة في قيمة تانية.

terms.definitionEn: An arithmetic operation that splits a value into equal parts.
terms.definitionAr: عملية حسابية بتقسم قيمة على قيمة تانية.

terms.definitionEn: The leftover amount after one number is divided by another.
terms.definitionAr: القيمة اللي بتفضل بعد قسمة رقم على رقم تاني.

terms.definitionEn: An operation that increases a numeric value by one.
terms.definitionAr: عملية بتزوّد القيمة الرقمية بمقدار واحد.

terms.definitionEn: An operation that decreases a numeric value by one.
terms.definitionAr: عملية بتقلل القيمة الرقمية بمقدار واحد.

terms.definitionEn: A number representation used for values that can include a fractional part.
terms.definitionAr: طريقة لتمثيل أرقام ممكن يكون فيها جزء عشري زي 2.5.

terms.definitionEn: The rules that determine which operations are evaluated first.
terms.definitionAr: قواعد بتحدد أنهي عملية تتحسب الأول لما يكون في أكتر من عملية.

terms.definitionEn: A shorthand operation that calculates with and reassigns to the same binding.
terms.definitionAr: صيغة مختصرة بتحسب على القيمة الحالية وبتخزن النتيجة في نفس الاسم.

terms.definitionEn: A built-in function that parses an integer from the start of a string.
terms.definitionAr: دالة جاهزة بتحاول تقرأ رقم صحيح من بداية النص.

terms.definitionEn: The base that specifies how digits in a numeral are interpreted.
terms.definitionAr: الأساس اللي بيحدد نظام قراءة الرقم، زي أساس 10 أو أساس 2.

questions.explanation: The plus operator adds the numeric operands.
Subtracting 6 from 18 gives 12.
Multiplying 2.5 by 4 gives 10.

Binary floating-point cannot represent these decimal fractions exactly, so the computed sum is not exactly 0.3.

questions.question: How can the remainder operator help identify whether an integer is even?
keyPoints: Odd integers leave remainder one for positive integers
Use a comparison to produce a boolean
questions.modelAnswer: An integer is even when dividing it by two leaves a remainder of zero, so a check like n % 2 === 0 returns a boolean. For a general divisibility check, compare the remainder to zero using the chosen divisor.

questions.question: Why should code often pass a radix to parseInt?
keyPoints: The radix specifies the numeral base
Other bases interpret the same digits differently
questions.modelAnswer: The radix tells parseInt which number base to use, making the intended interpretation explicit. For ordinary decimal text, passing 10 avoids relying on implicit choices and makes code easier to understand.

questions.question: Why can a decimal calculation such as 0.1 + 0.2 fail an exact equality check against 0.3?
keyPoints: Many decimal fractions lack exact binary representations
Rounding error can remain after arithmetic
Use a tolerance for approximate comparisons
questions.modelAnswer: JavaScript Number values use binary floating-point, and values such as 0.1 cannot be represented exactly in that format. Their arithmetic can therefore produce a nearby value rather than exactly 0.3; numeric code can compare within an appropriate tolerance when approximation is expected.
